card.name: Start of numbers and initials
card.fires_on: The first character of a number or initial right after a comma, colon, or opening bracket, such as the 1 in a strength or the B in an author's initials. Also digits inside amounts and decimals.

modes.label: Digits in strengths and amounts
modes.description: The first or middle digit of a strength, dose, or concentration figure.

modes.label: Number words and spaces before amounts
modes.description: A spelled-out count or a gap right before a quantity.
modes.example: the dosing frequency may be increased to<< one>> application every four hours.
